speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two leaves by ten, and I know more of this house tonight than I knew on Friday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Bay salt and white. Moulded, dipped, and rush-light. Pale malt and brown. Two bushels, and the four struck. The old furlong with its l put back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The oilcloth stayed tied all day. Not a line of the play. Tomorrow at six, Bartholomew's barley.
